Resolves #20618

The `github-actions` entry in `.github/dependabot.yml` gets the npm entry's cooldown. The Skills workflows (`neomjs/neo-agent-skills*`) skip the default three-day hold, and every other action keeps it. Dependabot already moves the fixed `@vX.Y.Z` workflow refs, and auto-merge lands them. The hold was the only reason a Skills release needed a hand-moved ref, as in #20598 and #20612.

Evidence: L1 (config diff; the measurement below is from existing Dependabot PRs) → L2 required (AC-2, post-merge: the run this config change triggers). Residual: AC-2, Residual-Owner: post-merge validation below.

Micro-review eligible: config-leaf — one YAML key on one ecosystem entry, mirroring the npm entry beside it.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 (the `github-actions` entry exempts the Skills workflows from the cooldown; every other actions dependency keeps the 3-day hold) | The diff: `cooldown: {default-days: 3, exclude: ["neomjs/neo-agent-skills*"]}` on the `github-actions` entry only. GitHub Docs list `default-days` as supported for GitHub Actions, and `exclude` as supporting `*`. |
| AC-2 (post-merge: the next `actions` run proposes the newest Skills release for every Skills workflow ref) | Post-merge. The config change itself triggers a Dependabot run; see below. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive.

## Test Evidence

The hold, measured from existing PRs. On 2026-11-08, the `actions` updates in all four consumers moved the Skills refs to `0.1.90` (2026-11-05) and skipped `0.1.91`–`1.2.0`, which were each under three days old: Engine #20610, Brain #1522, Institution #893, devindex #125. The cooldown-exempt npm updates in the same runs took `1.1.0` and `1.2.0`. A "never crosses a major" rule would have picked `0.1.98` instead.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [x] The run this change triggers moves `pr-review.yml` and `dependabot-automerge.yml` from `v0.1.90` to the newest `v1.x`. If it doesn't, the `exclude` name doesn't match, and the follow-up lists the three workflow names explicitly. The merge triggered `github_actions` run [`42533283742`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/42533283742) 7 s later. Its job definition carries `"exclude":["neomjs/neo-agent-skills*"]`, and for both refs the log reads `Latest version is 1.2.0`. It opened #20628 94 s after the merge, moving both from `v0.1.90` to `v1.2.0`.
